import json,copy,work
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json'))
allowed=set(schema['properties']); required=set(schema['required'])
assert len(report)==len(requests)
assert report==[work.evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
for item in report:
 assert set(item)==allowed==required
 assert item['status'] in schema['properties']['status']['enum']
 assert isinstance(item['sources'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['sources'])
 assert isinstance(item['unknowns'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['unknowns'])
print('manual-schema-and-report-ok',len(report))
